translations.web: Your words have supported him who was falling, You have made firm the feeble knees.
translations.bsb: Your words have steadied those who stumbled; you have braced the knees that were buckling.
translations.kjv: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
